title: Ultrasound Guided Arthrocentesis
brief_summary: Does ultrasound guidance improve success rate and decrease aspiration attempts for peripheral arthrocentesis?
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age at or over 18
* Indication for peripheral arthrocentesis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Hemodynamic instability
* Previous arthroplasty of the joint
* Known intraarticular fracture
* Hip arthrocentesis
